title: Record that three or more moved corrections do not emit on length-5 G20 intervals.
body:
<!-- CURSOR_AGENT_PR_BODY_BEGIN -->

## Change and mathematical scope

Exhaustive finite census, proved by a complete case split. No new κ, and the selected conditional value stays `781451/250000000`.

On the emitted local word of PR #5708, move three, four, or five corrections of every A2 conjugation with exactly five contacts onto other frames of the published one-edge route table. The corrections that are not chosen stay on their contact frames. The new frames may be equal. There are 133 intervals and 13,840,035,444,873,750 assignments. Every assignment misses a published edge. None emits, so none lowers the paid-query moment on `(0, 1)`.

The emitter stops at the first missing route. Every assignment has a unique pair of earliest moved corrections and agrees with the two-move word on that pair through the rejecting record. The length-5 two-move census of #6963 is recomputed: 536,289,250 assignments, 4,331 tails, no emission. Each of those 4,331 tails misses an edge before the next correction, at a distance of 2 to 329 records, so every later frame choice is unread. The early extensions are 13,838,927,940,076,445 assignments and the tail extensions are 1,107,504,797,305. Those classes partition the mask count `133 × (10 × 635³ + 5 × 635⁴ + 635⁵)`.

The least interval in scalar-position order is included. Its outer gates are indexes 1,119 and 8,918, both `ADD(572, 22)`. None of its two-move pairs reaches a tail, so all 104,060,416,878,750 of its three-or-more assignments are early rejections. The first recorded tail is interval `5,673..7,030`, corrections 1 and 2 moved to frames 594 and 353. It misses `ADD(173, 312)` at rewritten index 6,306; the next correction begins at index 6,547.

This is the length-exactly-5 three-or-more census on one word and one route table. It leaves length at least 6, the three-or-more question at 3 or 4 contacts, and any added route untouched. A missing edge is a rejection on this table. It is not a proof of unrestricted nonexistence, and it does not change the selected frontier.

## Task and overlap

Base `17469fff78c22941280f04d39dc5a1faee09c840`, priority revision 8. Card `bit-helper-contract`, scope refined. The card says to review the #5679/#5708 chain and stop when a proposed cut does not improve the paid moment. This package answers open question 2 of #6963 on every length-5 interval, which is the question posed in discussion comment https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19507176.

The two-move length-5 census is #6963 and is recomputed here as the reduction lemma, not offered as a new theorem. The one-move length-at-least-5 census is #6923. The two-move census at 2, 3 and 4 contacts is #6664. Three or more moves at 3 or 4 contacts remain the open question in `research/g20-two-moved-corrections`. Two moves at length at least 6 remain question 1 of #6963. No open PR enumerates this three-or-more length-5 domain. Local overlap search covered 10,180 notes at this base and found those predecessors only.

## Validation

Python 3.12, standard library, from the repository root. Both registered commands passed locally in about 30 seconds each:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/g20-length5-three-move/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/g20-length5-three-move/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/g20-length5-three-move
```

`scripts/research_package.py` printed `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/g20-length5-three-move outcome=negative-result`. The direct verifier prints

```text
PASS_G20_LENGTH5_THREE_MOVE intervals=133 assignments=13840035444873750 early_extensions=13838927940076445 tail_extensions=1107504797305 tails=4331 tail_j1=4305 tail_j2=7 tail_j3=19 min_gap=2 max_gap=329 emitted=0 savings=0 first_interval=1119-8918/104060416878750/0 first_tail=5673-7030/1/2/594/353/6306/6547 cold_early=100 cold_tails=4331 cold_maximal=3 one_move_control=3H2-H4 length6_open=86 no_new_kappa=true
```

Checks raise exceptions, so `-O` keeps them. Cold controls rebuild every tail from scratch, move one further correction on each of the 4,331 tails, move every later correction on one tail of each later-slot count, and extend 25 early two-move samples from each rejection class. One published length-5 one-move emission from #6923 is replayed as a positive control outside this domain; its histogram difference is `3 H2 − H4`, a strict loss. `scripts/check_research_commit.py` passed for commit `b97d14029225dbac298f96ad24e19eceb6d60258`.

Not run: the #5708 integration replay, the 18-call caller, adjoint columns, moduli 101 and 10201, ordinary admission, Lean, Docker, and `make frontier6030-verify`.

## Credit

The emitted word, route table, A2 relation, and local-only conjugation count are Ali Romman's `research/g20-conjugation-admission`, following Dugongue, ai-nanachi, and the retained G20 lineage named there. The length-4-and-above contact-frame obstruction is Nick Petalas's #6305. The two-move classification at lengths 2..4, and the prefix machine reimplemented here, are Nick Petalas's #6664. The one-move obstructions are unpaidmoon's #6337, #6633 and #6923. The length-5 two-move census and the 4,331 tail count are unpaidmoon's #6963.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Can three or more moved corrections in one interval of length at least 6 emit and lower the paid moment on this word and route table? Length 6 has 86 intervals. The first step is one length-6 interval with three corrections moved on this route table. No length-5 three-or-more assignment emits, so none supplies a saving seed, and the length-5 case split does not cover a longer interval. Two moves at length at least 6 remain question 1 of #6963.

#6923 question 2, one added route at the first missing edge of a dirty one-move failure, stays on that package. The published route table is held fixed.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The #6963 package layout and the minimal package generator made the reduction checkable. No process change requested. https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1200
